text: Pretty but lousy.. Condensation wicks through the cedar. You have no protection.

product_metadata.title: Avocrafts Wooden Coasters Set, Epoxy Coasters, Modern Coasters with Holder, Cedar Wood Coaster (4, Add Holder)
features: Handcrafted out of beautiful natural cedar wood and epoxy resin. Creates for a stunning look that combines the natural and man made.

Protect your tables and countertops from condensation and awful water rings while adding style to your home. No more boring coasters with these elegant gorgeous coasters than can be used for HOT & COLD drinks.
Natural cedar aroma that drifts you away to the forest. These coasters have a wonderful cedar smell that can impress your guests beyond measure.
Perfect sized coasters for your wine glasses, beer pints, and coffee cups, measuring square 3.5" x 3.5"
Matching epoxy resin wood holder available! The same holder is used for the 4 and 6 coaster set. It holds up to 6 coasters, but works great for 4!
